schemes.title: Arunachal Pradesh Inner Line Permit (e-ILP)
schemes.department: Department of Political, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Any Indian who is not a resident of Arunachal Pradesh needs an Inner Line Permit to enter the state. It used to mean queuing at a liaison office; the e-ILP portal issues it online in a day or two, and the permit is shown on a phone at the check gate.
schemes.benefit: Inner Line Permit issued online, valid for the days and districts you ask for
eligibility: Indian citizen who is not a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh
A temporary permit is for a visit; a regular permit is for work or a longer stay and needs a sponsor
One permit per person; children travelling with a parent are added to that permit
Foreign nationals need a Protected Area Permit instead, not this
documents: Aadhaar card, voter card or passport as photo identity
Travel details — the districts you will visit and the dates
Sponsor's details, for a regular permit for work
Vehicle registration number, if you are driving in

demoFields.label: Type of permit
demoFields.hint: Temporary for a visit, regular for work or a long stay. A regular permit needs a sponsor in the state.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on the photo ID)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the identity document you upload. The check gate compares the two.

demoFields.label: Photo Identity type and number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar, voter card or passport. Carry the same document with you, because it is checked at the gate.

demoFields.label: Districts to be visited
demoFields.hint: Name every district on your route. The permit is valid only for the districts written on it, and the gate turns you back for the rest.

demoFields.label: Dates of travel
demoFields.hint: From and to. Ask for a couple of days more than you plan — extending a permit from inside the state is harder than getting it right now.

demoFields.label: Purpose of visit
demoFields.hint: Tourism, business, work, or visiting family. A work purpose turns it into a regular permit needing a sponsor.

demoFields.label: Persons travelling with you
demoFields.hint: Children travelling with a parent go on the same permit. Adults each need their own.

demoFields.label: Vehicle Registration Number
demoFields.hint: Fill it if you are driving in. It is checked at the gate along with the permit.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The permit comes here as a downloadable file. Save it to your phone before you set off — the network on the road is poor.

demoSteps: Apply on eilp.arunachal.gov.in at least a few days before you travel. Most temporary permits come within one or two working days.
Fill the form, naming every district on your route. A permit that does not list a district will not get you past its gate.
Upload your photo identity and photograph, pay the fee online and note the application number.
Wait for the approval message, then download the permit and save it to your phone. Print a copy too, since the network in the hills is unreliable.
Carry the same identity document you uploaded. At the check gate the permit and the document are compared.
If you need to stay longer or visit a district not on the permit, apply for an extension before the permit expires rather than after.
schemes.helpline: The Deputy Commissioner's office of the district you are entering

schemes.title: Chandigarh e-Services — Certificates and Citizen Services
schemes.brief: Chandigarh's single window for certificates and citizen services — residence, income, caste, birth and death registration, and a range of departmental permissions. The e-Sampark centres across the sectors do the same things across a counter.
schemes.benefit: Residence, income, caste and birth certificates applied for online or at an e-Sampark centre
eligibility: Resident of Chandigarh, applying from the address where you live
A residence certificate needs proof that you have lived in Chandigarh for the qualifying period
A caste certificate needs the caste to be on the Chandigarh SC or OBC list
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Ration card or voter card as residence proof
Electricity or water bill for the address
Father's caste certificate or a school record, for a caste certificate
Salary slips or Form 16, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Residence, income, caste, birth or death certificate, or a departmental permission. Each has its own form and fee.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the records; essential for a caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Full address with sector and house number
demoFields.hint: The address you actually live at. The verification is done there.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Chandigarh
demoFields.hint: For a residence certificate, say from when. The ration card, school records or an old electricity bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year. Keep it consistent with the salary slips you upload.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: College admission under the Chandigarh quota
demoFields.hint: Written for the record. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on eservices.chd.gov.in with your mobile, or walk into any e-Sampark centre, which files it across the counter for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar and the address proof.
Upload the documents, pay the fee online, and keep the application number from the acknowledgement.
The area official verifies the address, usually within a week. Be reachable on the mobile you gave.
The signed certificate is issued and downloaded from the same login, or collected at the e-Sampark centre.
If it runs past the time the service promises, quote the application number to the Deputy Commissioner's office.

schemes.title: Chandigarh Housing Board — Flats and Allotment Services
schemes.brief: The Chandigarh Housing Board's own online counter — new scheme applications, instalment and rent payments, transfer of a flat, need-based change requests, no-dues certificates and the e-auction of leftover units. Almost everything an allottee used to queue for is here.
schemes.benefit: Board flat applications, payments, transfers and no-dues certificates online
eligibility: For a new scheme, the conditions set out in that scheme's brochure, usually including Chandigarh residence
For allottee services, you must be the recorded allottee or a legal heir
A transfer needs the dues cleared and the Board's permission before the deed
One flat per family under the subsidised categories
documents: Allotment letter, for an existing allottee
Income proof, for a category-based scheme
Latest payment receipts, for a no-dues certificate
Succession certificate or a will, for a transfer on inheritance

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New scheme application, instalment or rent payment, transfer, need-based change, no-dues certificate, or e-auction. Pick the one you need.

demoFields.label: Allottee Name (as on the allotment letter)
demoFields.hint: As on the allotment letter, which is what the Board's record follows, even if Aadhaar spells it differently.

demoFields.label: Allotment / File Number
demoFields.hint: From the allotment letter. Every service is looked up against it, so keep the letter safe.

demoFields.label: Dwelling unit and sector
demoFields.hint: As recorded by the Board, which may differ from how the post office writes it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar and PAN
demoFields.hint: Both are needed for a transfer or a new purchase, because it is a property transaction.

demoFields.label: Amount being paid (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The portal shows what is due. Pay from that figure rather than an old demand letter, since interest may have been added.

demoFields.label: Reason, for a transfer or a change
demoFields.hint: For a transfer, say sale, gift or inheritance and attach the papers. A need-based change needs the sanctioned plan.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The receipt, the demand notices and every Board notice come here.

demoSteps: Register on chbonline.in with your allotment or file number, Aadhaar and mobile, and confirm the OTP.
Choose the service. For a payment, check the amount the portal shows against your own record before paying — interest may have been added since the last demand.
Pay online and download the receipt at once. Keep every receipt until the final no-dues certificate is issued.
For a transfer, apply for the Board's permission first and clear the dues. A deed signed before that permission is not recognised.
For a new scheme, read the brochure for the price, the category and the closing date, then apply and pay the registration money in time.
Track the application on the portal by the file number, and take anything unresolved to the Board's office in Sector 9 with the application number.
